question: What claim is made about the yoginī named Icchā with respect to her extent and the agency by which she is known?
premises: The yoginī named Icchā extends up to Māyā.
She is known by the siddhas.
This is said by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī named Icchā, known by the siddhas, extends up to Māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The precise relation between supreme will and the siddhas is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas, extends up to Māyā by supreme will.
